title: Aakash & Prakash Mehta: Dark
overview: Thoughts that should not be thought out loud. Jokes that tread the line of black and white. Not for the weak of heart or strong of opinion. Dark is hosted by Aakash and performed by his twin brother Prakash Mehta, a man who has lost everything. He uses humour to cope with his divorce and life’s absurdities, bringing you the darkest material in town.
